title: From Rogue to Safe AI: The Role of Explicit Refusals in Aligning LLMs with International Humanitarian Law
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLM alignment with International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and International Human Rights Law (IHRL), which it frames as ethical and legal foundations for human dignity. It evaluates the 'ethical reasoning' and 'moral reasoning' provided in model refusals and includes the protection of religious personnel as part of its evaluative ruleset.
